architecture.webAndApi: EdgeOne Makers Free with Vite/React and same-origin Node.js Cloud Functions
architecture.databaseAndMedia: Supabase Free PostgreSQL and private Storage
architecture.deploymentModel: GitHub validates and migrates first, then ordinary fast-forward promotion to EdgeOne Git Integration deployment branches

governance: Deploy workflows are manual only and use GitHub Environments.
Tests, typecheck, and build run before any database mutation.
Checksum-locked Supabase migration runs before EdgeOne deployment branch promotion.
Deployment branches reject non-fast-forward movement and never use force push.
EdgeOne build cannot mutate the database.
Staging has a database-only bootstrap mode so schema/storage exist before the first EdgeOne project import.
Production requires accepted Staging SHA, identical source, explicit approval, encrypted export, restore drill, Free-plan confirmation, and no-billing confirmation.
Paid plans, usage-based billing, automatic upgrades, and retired provider secrets are forbidden.

verification.validationRuntime: Node 18 compatibility run; canonical Node 22 / pnpm 9.15.9 full root verification is Step 15
